meta.title: IEEE ISITCom Student Branch
meta.description: IEEE Student Branch of ISITCom Hammam Sousse

home.heroDescription: A place to learn, experiment, and turn ideas into real projects. Join the IEEE community at ISITCom in Hammam Sousse.
home.aboutTitle: Ideas come to life when we share them.
home.aboutDescription: The IEEE Student Branch at ISITCom brings together students passionate about engineering, computing, and technology. Together, we create opportunities to learn by doing, meet professionals, and contribute to an international community.
home.focusDescription: The IEEE experience complements coursework with hands-on practice, knowledge sharing, and connections that reach beyond campus.

focus.technologyDescription: Discover IEEE's technical fields and build useful skills through hands-on experiences.
focus.innovationDescription: Imagine, prototype, and grow projects that respond to real challenges.
focus.communityDescription: Connect with peers, faculty, and professionals as part of a worldwide network.

home.activitiesTitle: A community that learns by doing.
home.activitiesIntro: Workshops, collaborative projects, and meetups: there is a way for everyone to get involved, whatever your starting point.

activities.workshopsDescription: Welcoming sessions to practice, discover new tools, and make progress together.
activities.projectsDescription: Cross-disciplinary teams taking ideas from a notebook to a working prototype.
activities.networkDescription: Conversations with speakers, alumni, and the IEEE community in Tunisia and beyond.

home.joinTitle: Have an idea? There is a place for you.
home.joinDescription: Whether you are just starting out or have been curious for years, come meet the community and build something together.

events.heading: Ideas come to life when we get together.
events.description: Workshops, talks, and meetups organized by the IEEE Student Branch. Find upcoming dates and moments we've shared.
